node.title: Re^3: Syntax Question Related to "join" on a Complex Data Structure
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [perldigious],

[tybalt89]'s suggestion appears to be [doc://perlref#Postfix-Reference-Slicing], which is part of the new [doc://perlref#Postfix-Dereference-Syntax], which says:

In Perl 5.20 and 5.22, this syntax must be enabled with use feature 'postderef'. As of Perl 5.24, no feature declarations are required to make it available.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
